title: Weak Verbs — Class II
subtitle: Lufian, macian — the -ō- suffix.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Old English poetry and prose.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Class II weak verbs have -ia- in the infinitive. First-person singular present has -ie. Present: ic lufie, þū lufast, hē lufaþ. Past: ic lufode, þū lufodest, hē lufode. Past participle: gelufod.
